en_title: Gola Bazar Police Book Six After DJ Volume Dispute in Kotia Nayak
en_seo_title: Gola Bazar Police Book Six After DJ Volume Dispute in Kotia Nayak
en_body: A dispute over loud DJ music in Kotia Nayak village, within the Gola police station area of Gorakhpur district, led to a police complaint against six people. According to local reporting, two young men allegedly asked for the music volume to be reduced during Diwali celebrations and were then assaulted. The complaint alleges physical violence and threats. Police reportedly registered a case against six accused people. The allegations remain subject to investigation; registration of a case does not establish guilt. The incident has drawn attention to how noise disagreements during celebrations can escalate. Residents should contact police or local authorities when disputes become threatening. Further findings and any legal outcome have not been confirmed in the cited reporting.
